newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hipro to issue 135 mln baht shares.
newsitem.headline: Hipro to issue 135 mln baht shares.

text.p: Thai electronics firm Hipro Electronics Plc said on Monday it will issue 13.5 million new shares to raise 135 million baht ($5.19 million).

Hipro said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand it will issue 5.4 million shares in a rights issue at five old shares for one new share. Registration for the issue closes on June 9 and subscription and payment is set for August 18-22.
Hipro said it will issue another 6.075 million shares at 26 baht per share but gave no further details. An additional 2.025 million shares are to be reserved for exercise, the company said.
The issue will raise Hipro's registered capital to 405 million baht from 270 million baht, the statement said. ($1 = 26 baht)
